item.title: Agri co-op giant CHS completes upgrade to deep water port
item.description: Farmer-owned grain co-op CHS recently completed the modernization of its deep water port at Galveston, Texas. It says the work will improve on-time delivery of imported dry fertiliser to farmers in the north, central and northwest part of the US. The post Agri co-op giant CHS completes upgrade to deep water port appeared first on Co-operative News.

item.title: Future Co-ops conference to explore reclaiming power for communities
item.description: At the end of February, the UK’s 2026 Future Co-ops Conference will explore ways the co-op movement can challenge the far-right and reclaim power for communities. “Across the UK, society is divided,” say the organisers, co-op development agency, Co-operative Futures. The post Future Co-ops conference to explore reclaiming power for communities appeared first on Co-operative News.
